textRuns.value: Source: EFFIS perimeters (Copernicus EMS / JRC) and World Bank forest area. Normalisation divides burnt hectares by total forest area, so it overstates a strict rate wherever fires burn non-forest land (cropland, steppe, scrub), common in the east: read it as exposure relative to forest endowment, not forest lost. Russia is excluded from the map only, for viewport legibility; it remains in both rankings.
